config.net_gain_accounting: net = (B0 mean - arm mean) - planner CPU ms, 1 ms CPU = 1 ms episode budget (disclosed convention)

criteria.B2_vs_B1: distilled value function vs max-U; significant improvement -> U underuses future info
criteria.B5_vs_B1: high-budget rollout reference vs max-U: how much extra gain is available
criteria.B2_B3_vs_B5: whether low-compute methods retain the high-budget gains
criteria.high_budget_scope: approximate optimum under limited candidates + sampled scenarios only; NOT global optimum
criteria.non_significance_rule: CI containing 0 supports neither difference nor equivalence
